description: DB-backed happy path: call the real TicketService.update to close then reopen a fixture ticket; compare all returned closure fields with the persisted row and GET projection after each update, including exact timestamp equality.

Parameterize both PUT controller paths: close and reopen a ticket and assert the serialized success payload exposes final closure values and preserves the existing envelope and description fields; use real persistence or pair controller tests with T001.

DB-backed transition sequence: closed-to-closed and repeated closed status preserve the original timestamp/actor; after reopening, open-to-open, repeated open status, and a title-only update retain false/null/null closure state.

DB-backed guard cases: reject a status from another tenant/board and a close blocked by configured close rules; verify the original status and all closure fields remain unchanged and no other tenant ticket is modified.

Manual API smoke on the wired local stack: close and reopen via each real PUT endpoint, record response plus follow-up GET, and verify is_closed versus status_is_closed and exact closure metadata consistency; redact API keys.
